title: [dogfood:P0] WebSocket live spectate delivers ZERO game events (server-side); the UI 'Connected' badge is transport-only
detail: Dogfood tick 2026-09-25, first-ever WS surface test. Probe evidence: ws client connected to ws://localhost:3004/ws, sent {type:'SUBSCRIBE',payload:{gameId}}, received CONNECTED + SUBSCRIBED acks, then ZERO GAME_EVENT/BROADCAST messages over 70s while real game 96f512bc ran its full lifecycle (13+ events, ended ENDED winner=TOWN) inside the probe window. The spectate page only updates on manual reload. Root cause chain: (1) client subscribes via JOIN_GAME (apps/web/src/hooks/useGameEvents.ts:67); (2) handleJoinGame registers an EventBus subscription on topic `game:<id>` (apps/server/src/websocket/index.ts:181-189) but EventBus topics are event-type-keyed and the legacy adapter publishes by event type (apps/server/src/services/event-bus.ts:50-74, apps/server/src/services/legacy-game-adapter.ts:951) — nothing ever publishes to `game:<id>`; (3) the join callback additionally broadcasts with excludeClientId: clientId (websocket/index.ts:186), excluding the very client that joined, so even a second client would be needed AND the first would still get nothing. Fix direction: subscribe joiners to the event types the adapter actually publishes (or make the adapter publish a game-scoped mirror topic), and drop excludeClientId on the join path. Verify: SUBSCRIBE/JOIN a live game via ws and count GAME_EVENT frames > 0 before the game ends.
